localizedValues.description: Located beside Alouette Lake near Boat Launch - follow the main park road 7km from the park entrance to the Boat Launch road, follow Boat Launch road and the group campground is on the left just before the lake. Pit toilets only, no flush toilets or showers, no hook-ups. Water tap available April 1st to October 14th, no water available October 15th to March 31st.  This group campground was designed for tents, and is not suitable for larger RV's. May be noisy in summer due to proximity to Boat Launch.  Groups arriving between October 15th and March 31st (Winter season) must arrive before 7pm when the park main gate closes.

localizedValues.name: G1-Golden Ears Group
localizedValues.description: Located adjacent to West Canyon Parking Lot - follow the main park road 11km from the park entrance, at the fork go left onto the gravel road, then turn left to West Canyon Parking Lot. Group campground has an eating shelter with picnic tables and wood stove. Pit toilets only, no flush toilets or showers, no hook-ups. Water tap available April 1st to October 15th. No water available October 16th to March 31st. No vehicle or RV access past designated parking areas, approximately 100ft from shelter. There is parking for 12 vehicles and 4 small RV trailers. This group campground was designed for tents, and cannot accommodate vehicle/RV combinations greater than 39 ft in length. Parking on the roadway is not permitted as emergency vehicle access to the area must be maintained at all times. Groups arriving between October 16th and March 31st (Winter season) must arrive before 7pm when the park main gate closes.

localizedValues.name: G2-Alouette Group
localizedValues.description: Located beside Alouette Lake near Boat Launch. Pit toilets only, no flush toilets or showers, no hook-ups. A water tap is available April 1st to October 15th, no water available October 16th to March 31st. This group campground was designed for tents and is not suitable for larger RV's. May be noisy in summer due to proximity to Boat Launch. Groups arriving between October 16th and March 31st (Winter season) must arrive before 7pm when the park main gate closes.

localizedValues.name: G3-Woodlands Group
localizedValues.description: Located just off the Golden Ears Parkway at the Northern end of the park - follow the main park road 11km from the park entrance, at the fork veer left onto the gravel roadway, then turn left into the groupsite at the first opportunity. This groupsite consists of 8 individual campsites each with a picnic table and fire pit. Each campsite is 50 ft in length and can accommodate 2 vehicles or 1 vehicle/RV trailer combination per site. There are two additional visitor parking stalls. Pit toilet only, no flush toilets or showers, no electric hook-ups. A water tap is available April 1st to October 15th, no water available October 16th to March 31st. This groupsite is available for both equestrian and non-equestrian use. Equestrian high-line posts are available with two horses allowed per high-line, there are 3 small corrals with two horses allowed per corral. Groups arriving between October 16th and March 31st (Winter season) must arrive before 7pm when the park main gate closes.
